content:
**Cajun Rice & Beans** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A can of preserved cajun rice and beans.

- Four can be found on shelves at the South Mountain Lookout.
- Three can be found in the Sunday Brothers' Cabin.
- One can be found in a trailer southwest of Graninger Farm.
- One can be found on the roof of the Crab Shack near the Toxic Dried Lakebed.

The words "who dat!?" can be seen on the bottom of the can.

- Who dat!?
